title: Im not going to think myself into the glooms
html_source: Molly’s last name is Bloom and it’s something she has taken after marrying Leopold. But it is something she questions after the loss of her child, and therefore she relates her last name with gloom and how she wishes to no longer have such feelings of sadness. Even though such feelings just like her last name can’t be easily changed.
